description: This PHP class defines a form processor for editing SDG (Sustainable Development Goals) categories in an admin interface, including form creation, validation, and saving logic.

classes.name: AdminSdgEditForm
classes.description: A form processor class for editing SDG categories in the admin panel, handling form creation, validation, and saving.

methods.name: getConstraints
methods.description: Returns validation constraints for the form, requiring fields to be not blank.

methods.name: createForm
methods.description: Builds the form with fields for name, description, icon, and footprints, populating choices from Footprint data.

methods.name: save
methods.description: Validates and saves form data, updates the model, and handles image and footprint associations.
